covers: The bytes of the file on disk, whole and unmodified, including its trailing newline. Not the canonical form of section 4 of the canonical commercial model, which covers commercial objects rather than schema documents.
description: Digest of every schema file in the release, required by RELEASES.md section 3.2. A schema whose digest differs from the digest recorded here is not this release. Checked on every push and pull request by .github/scripts/check-schema-digests.py.

conformance_manifest.note: The manifest as released, required by RELEASES.md section 3.3. Recorded here so that the fixture set a release names is as verifiable as the schemas it validates against.
